name: forktah
description: Plugins that ship with Forktah, the gtownarmy-design fork of CControlCenter (agentmux and the Controls Control Center).

plugins.name: ccc-board
plugins.description: The Control Center board inside Claude Code: tickets, evidence, the journal and file claims, with hooks for the session summary, native-task mirroring, a Stop gate and park-on-exit.

plugins.name: voice-cli
plugins.description: See and steer Voice CLI, the local Whisper push-to-talk app in voice-cli/: lock it onto a terminal, switch mode or microphone, and hear the operator's next spoken phrase.
